title: THE tSZ + DUST JOINT: the y-profile with the r^-1 dust envelope (G113's phantom-zone pressure x G122's closed coherency)
recipe: P_e^dust(r) = P_e^G113(r) x D(r);  D(r) = 1 for r <= r_M (y0 unchanged, the core) and D(r) = a_c (r/R500)^-0.99 for r > r_M, a_c the committed G122 per-cluster amplitudes, p* = 0.99; the dust is COLD (no pressure), the baryons in its well supply the support: the envelope is the virial temperature contribution of the dust's enclosed mass (M_dust ~ const, T_dust ~ 1/r); the Abel transform of the r^-0.99 factor shifts the projected outer slope by -0.99: y ~ b^-(q-0.01) ~ b^-q

physics.sector1: the phantom-zone pressure (G113): T -> T_inf = 2 T_floor isotherm beyond r_M (the virial of the phantom mass), y ~ b^-(q-1)
physics.sector2: the dust (G122): c_dust = a_c (r/R500)^-0.99, ONE universal shape, per-cluster amplitudes; cold, gravitational only
physics.dust_well: M_dust(<r) = M_dyn(<r)(c_dust - 1) (deep-regime virial reading, inside the fit window); the pressure is the baryons' hydrostatic support in the deepened well
physics.joint_outer_slope: y ~ b^-(q - 0.01) ~ b^-q: the two sectors' exponents add in the outer Compton falloff

V1_revised_outer_y_at_2R500.statement: the joint number at 2 R500: 0.30x the phantom-only amplitude median (range 0.23-0.40, the LOS-weighted envelope over r >= 2 R500), 2-bin slope -2.5, ~31x the classic beta = 2/3 reading (G113 alone 105x); y0 unchanged inside r_M by construction (total-LOS y0 moves median +13% through the r > r_M shell)

V2_joint_discriminating_power.omega_statement: the outer y-profile tests BOTH sectors jointly: F_JOINT vs F_phantom at 11.6 sigma pooled, vs F_classic at 5.2 sigma (G129's 0.09 forecast); tSZ alone cannot separate the r^-0.99 envelope from a steeper gas envelope / EFE cap -- the X-ray anchors (committed gas q, T_inf, r_M) make the outer tSZ bins read the envelope directly with 2 parameters

verdicts.V3_honest_statement: ONE OBSERVATION, TWO SECTORS.  The outer y-profile is the LOS projection of the baryon pressure support; in the framework the baryons sit in the wells of BOTH sectors -- the phantom (G113: the deep-regime isotherm T_inf = 2 T_floor, y ~ b^-(q-1), median slope -1.44 at 2 R500) and the cold dust whose r^-1 envelope (G122's closed coherency: c_dust = a_c (r/R500)^-0.99, committed per-cluster log10 a_c in [-0.23, +0.06]) deepens the well and adds a multiplicative factor D(r) above r_M that is 1 inside r_M (y0 UNCHANGED, the core) and a_c (r/R500)^-0.99 outside: +2.5x peak at r_M, crossing unity at r* ~ 0.82 R500 and falling to 0.30x of the phantom-only amplitude at 2 R500.  THE REVISED OUTER SLOPE: y ~ b^-(q-0.01) ~ b^-q, median -2.37 at 2 R500 -- the coherency's own SZ face: the two sectors' exponents ADD (-(q-1) from the phantom isotherm, -0.99 from the envelope); the joint number at 2 R500 sits at 1.17e-06 (median y(2R500), 31x the classic beta = 2/3 reading vs 105x for the phantom alone).  NOT CLAIMED: (i) that tSZ alone separates the sectors -- the single channel reads the product -- the r^-0.99 envelope is degenerate against the gas envelope and the EFE-cap alternative without the X-ray anchors (G130's T(r) plateau window and the committed gas profiles break it -- the JOINT fit is the claim); (ii) the envelope's continuation beyond the G122 fit window (600 kpc ~ 0.4-0.5 R500): c_dust at 1-2 R500 is the closed coherency's extrapolation, and the tSZ outer bins are the first DIRECT test of that extrapolation; (iii) A644's joint reading (q = 3.8, 2-bin slope -6.49) is the steepest, at or below the classic reading -- the envelope matters least where the gas itself falls steeply.  HONEST: the number at 2 R500: y_dust/y_G113 = 0.304 (the envelope's own amplitude at 2 R500), slope -2.37 -- the closed coherency's prediction is EXACTLY G113 x G122, zero new parameters.

checks.reading: between r_M and r* the r^-1 envelope multiplies the phantom-zone pressure by up to ~2.5x (median): THIS is what the dust adds outside r_M; beyond r* it falls below unity and the OUTER profile steepens by the same r^-0.99

checks.name: V1b [THE REVISED NUMBER AT 2 R500] y_dust(2 R500)/y_G113(2 R500) = the LOS-weighted mean of the envelope over r >= 2 R500 (dominated by r ~ 2-4 R500, D ~ 0.40 a_c): the projected ratio in (0.18, 0.65) for all 12 clusters, median ~ 0.30; the joint profile remains above the classic beta = 2/3 reading at 2 R500 with median ratio > 10
checks.measured: median y_dust/y_G113 at 2 R500 = 0.304 (range 0.228-0.397); median y/y(2/3) = 31.1 (G113 alone 105.4); 12/12 below the phantom-only reading
checks.reading: the G122 amplitudes (log10 a_c in [-0.23, +0.06]) sit below the R500 pivot, so beyond R500 the envelope sits at ~0.23-0.40x the phantom-only reading (LOS-averaged); the joint prediction is STEEPER and LOWER at 2 R500 -- the tSZ number that tests both sectors at once

checks.name: V1c [THE REVISED OUTER SLOPE PREDICTION] slope_dust(2 R500) = slope_G113(2 R500) - 0.99 (the Abel of the r^-0.99 factor): |shift - 0.99| <= 0.15 in >= 9/12 clusters; median slope in (-2.9, -1.9)
checks.reading: the r^-1 envelope steepens the outer Compton falloff by exactly one power: the joint reading is y ~ b^-(q-1+0.99) = b^-(q-0.01); the revised number at 2 R500: slope ~ -2.4 (median), 2-bin [R500, 2R500] ~ -2.2

checks.name: V1d [y0 unchanged, the core] the core (r <= r_M) keeps G113's pressure exactly: D = 1 there by construction; the total-LOS y0 moves only through the r > r_M shell: median y0_dust/y0 < 1.15
checks.reading: the central Compton parameter is still the committed gas x the virial total mass inside the measured well: the dust envelope is an OUTER structure (r > r_M); the amplitude of the joint prediction inherits G113's (hse median 0.99)

checks.name: V1e [the dust's well: baryon fraction] the dust's share of the enclosed mass at 600 kpc (deep-regime virial reading M_dust = M_dyn (c_dust - 1)) is in (0.2, 0.7) for >= 9/12 clusters and f_b = M_b/M_dust in (0.05, 1.0) at the well (median stated)
checks.measured: dust share 1 - 1/c_dust at 600 kpc: median 0.39 (range 0.29-0.55); f_b,dust = M_b/M_dust median 0.26 (range 0.11-0.60)
checks.reading: the dust is ~half the enclosed mass at 600 kpc (the last measured bin, inside the G122 window) and the baryon fraction in its well is ~20-30% -- the baryons in the dust's potential supply the revised pressure support; c_dust < 1 beyond r* inverts the virial reading and is reported only inside the fit window

checks.name: V2 [THE REVISED OMEGA: the joint discriminating power] the outer y-profile tests the phantom-zone pressure (G113) and the dust r^-1 envelope (G122) JOINTLY: the three-way slope separation is >= 5 sigma pooled (G129's 0.09 forecast)
checks.measured: F_JOINT (-2.54) vs F_phantom (-1.49): 1.05 = 11.6σ pooled; vs F_classic (-3): 0.46 = 5.2σ; F_phantom vs F_classic: 1.51 = 16.8σ (per-cluster 3.3/1.5/4.7)
checks.reading: WHAT tSZ ALONE CANNOT SEPARATE: a single Compton curve sees the PRODUCT n_e k_B T(phantom) x c_dust -- the exponent -(q - 0.01) is degenerate against a steeper gas envelope or a different isotherm, and the envelope amplitude a_c is degenerate with the gas normalization; WHAT THE JOINT FIT ADDS: the X-ray anchors fix q (the gas envelope from the committed fgas profile), r_M and T_inf (G113/G095) and n_e -- leaving the tSZ outer bins residuals to land on the envelope (p, a_c) with two parameters, i.e. the tSZ measurement reads the r^-1 envelope's slope and amplitude DIRECTLY once the phantom sector is X-ray-fixed; the EFE cap alternative (G108's capped reading steepens the outer profile without dust) is separated by the X-ray T(r) plateau window (G130), NOT by tSZ alone; the F_JOINT vs F_classic line (0.46 slope units) is the weakest of the three separations (5.2 sigma pooled, 1.5 per cluster) -- the joint+vary is sample-level
